title: umbilicus vulgaris subsp. gaditanus
intro: Umbilicus vulgaris subsp. gaditanus, commonly known as the Gaditan Orpine, is a plant species belonging to the Crassulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Umbilicus vulgaris subsp. gaditanus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
